name: openwukong-vscode-bridge
description: Local IDE extension bridge for OpenWukong connector-first supervision.

openwukong.bridge.port.description: Local port used by the OpenWukong IDE bridge. Use 0 to let the operating system assign an unused loopback port.

openwukong.bridge.autoPortOnConflict.description: When the preferred local bridge port is already in use, silently try nearby ports instead of interrupting the IDE session.

openwukong.bridge.portFallbackAttempts.description: Number of consecutive local ports to try when autoPortOnConflict is enabled.

openwukong.bridge.dynamicPortOnConflict.description: After the preferred and fallback ports are unavailable, bind to an operating-system-assigned unused port and publish it through the local bridge registry.

openwukong.bridge.silentAutoStartFailure.description: Suppress auto-start failure notifications so the bridge does not interrupt normal IDE work.

openwukong.bridge.host.description: Local host interface used by the OpenWukong IDE bridge.

openwukong.bridge.sendCommand.description: Optional IDE command id that receives OpenWukong send-message payloads.

openwukong.bridge.allowedCommands.description: IDE command ids that OpenWukong may execute through /v1/ide/command.

openwukong.bridge.chatAdapters.description: Named IDE chat adapters. Configure commandId or commandCandidates after inspecting commands exposed by the current IDE/product.

openwukong.bridge.chatCommandAwaitTimeou.description: Maximum time to wait for a chat adapter command to resolve before returning a dispatch-pending response. This prevents long-running Agent commands from blocking the local bridge.

openwukong.bridge.cursorReadCommandAwait.description: Maximum time to wait for Cursor read-only composer commands before returning state_status=pending. This keeps transcript/readback probes from blocking the local bridge while an Agent turn is active.

openwukong.bridge.cursorDraftHookCommand.description: Maximum time to wait for Cursor draft-hook command discovery or isolated draft commands before returning a structured pending response instead of blocking the local bridge.

openwukong.bridge.autoStart.description: Start the local IDE bridge when the extension activates. Keep this disabled in normal Cursor workspaces; use the start command or an isolated profile for tests.

openwukong.bridge.autoStartRequiresWorks.description: When autoStart is enabled, skip empty IDE windows until a workspace folder is present so background bridge discovery cannot bind an empty Cursor window.
